raw_text: Large-scale protests erupted across Northeast India on Tuesday following the implementation of the Citizenship Amendment Act. A near-total bandh was observed in Assam, Tripura, and parts of Meghalaya with road and rail networks severely disrupted. The Indian Express has confirmed that Telegram groups were used to coordinate protest logistics, with over 40 regional groups disseminating bandh instructions within a three-hour window.
clean_text: Large-scale anti-CAA protests across Northeast India caused near-total bandh in Assam, Tripura, and Meghalaya. Telegram groups coordinated protest logistics across 40+ regional channels.
